exposure: mode of birth (caesarean section vs spontaneous vaginal birth)
cohort: The study included 399 postpartum women in Ho, Ghana, who had given birth within the last 12 months.
finding: Caesarean section (CS) was associated with a 68% higher prevalence of screen-positive PPD compared with spontaneous vaginal birth (SVB).
mod_finding: CS was associated with a 68% higher prevalence of screen-positive PPD compared with SVB.
